wroom.evidence: Owner adopted the button processor on 2026-11-11 and delegated the pin choice (movable for wiring convenience). Chosen from the module's standard pinout and the DevKitC V4 header order recalled from memory, not yet checked against the datasheet. No strap pin (0, 2, 5, 12, 15), no flash pin (6 to 11), no console pin (1, 3). GPIO14 is left spare because it pulses at boot. GPIO16 is left spare as the UART2 receive pin for an optional return link. GPIO34, 35, 36 and 39 are input-only with no internal pull-up, so they carry buttons that the gamepad pulls up itself; if the button check (M4) shows a line floating when released, move it to a pin with an internal pull-up. Internal pull-ups stay off until then.
